speaker: NARRATOR
text: And her ambition was to extend her realm...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: to all the regions of the known world.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: To this end, she gathered an army.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And she bore a son, and named him Nekron.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And him she tutored in the black arts and in the powers of the mind.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And when Nekron came of age...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: and attained mastery of those powers...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: together they seized control of the region of Ice.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And from their castle called Ice Peak...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: they sent a giant glacier rumbling southward.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: No village or people could stand against its relentless onslaught.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And so the remnants of humanity fled south...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: and huddled for warmth among the volcanoes...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: of a mountain region ruled by a generous king named Jarol...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: from his fortress, which men called Fire Keep.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And still Nekron pushed the Ice ever southward...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: into the temperate zone toward Fire Keep.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And no one dared guess at the outcome...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: of a meeting on the field of battle...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: between Fire and Ice.

speaker: VILLAGE CHIEF
text: Hold your positions, men. Steady.

speaker: VILLAGE ELDER
text: Larn, it cannot be stopped. Join your brother.

speaker: JULIANA
text: You have done well, my son.

speaker: JULIANA
text: The North Village has fallen. We have won.

speaker: NEKRON
text: I want to thank you, Mother.

speaker: NEKRON
text: The Great Plain is all that stands between ourselves and Fire Keep.

speaker: JULIANA
text: That is a long distance.

speaker: NEKRON
text: A distance we may not have to travel.

speaker: NEKRON
text: I am sending our envoys to Jarol with our new demands.

speaker: JULIANA
text: He will not submit.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Perhaps.

speaker: NEKRON
text: You will present our demands to King Jarol at Fire Keep and...

speaker: NEKRON
text: give our royal regards to his lovely daughter.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: But, Father, I want to be with you when you meet Nekron's men.

speaker: JAROL
text: You will serve your people better here with your studies, my daughter.

speaker: JAROL
text: Give me your love.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: You have it always, Father.

speaker: TUTOR
text: All matter in our world is from the natural bases...

speaker: TUTOR
text: which are earth, air, fire and water...

speaker: TUTOR
text: the four elements from which all things are created.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: How can you talk about elements when the war draws nearer to us every hour?

speaker: TUTOR
text: Princess Teegra, we all have our duty.

speaker: TUTOR
text: Your father's duty is to be king and lead.

speaker: TUTOR
text: Your brother's duty is to soldier. And your duty is to learn.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: You mean my duty is to stay shut up...

speaker: TEEGRA
text: while all the men do the fighting and share all the glory.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: We think that stinks.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Don't we, Shaitan?

speaker: ENVOY
text: If you peacefully surrender, my lord Nekron will cease the destruction of-

speaker: TARO
text: This is your message of peace?

speaker: TARO
text: A demand for our total and unconditional surrender?

speaker: ENVOY
text: We call it an offer of alliance, Your Majesty.

speaker: TARO
text: I call it blackmail.

speaker: ENVOY
text: My lord Nekron's offer-

speaker: TARO
text: To hell with Nekron and his offer. We are free men, not slaves.

speaker: ENVOY
text: King Jarol, be reasonable.

speaker: JAROL
text: My son, Taro, speaks more with his heart than with his head.

speaker: JAROL
text: But he speaks for all of us.

speaker: JAROL
text: There can be no alliance.

speaker: JAROL
text: We will fight you to the death.

speaker: ENVOY
text: Perhaps, you will soon change your mind.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: No!

speaker: JAROL
text: Teegra!

speaker: JAROL
text: Guards!

speaker: JAROL
text: Make for the glacier. Man the Dragonhawks.

speaker: JAROL
text: Hurry!

speaker: TARO
text: The Dragonhawks will find her, Father. They've got to.

speaker: JAROL
text: The night's so dark, the jungle so thick. A bird couldn't find its own nest.

speaker: TARO
text: What do we do then, Father?

speaker: JAROL
text: We wait.

speaker: TARO
text: For Nekron's new demands?

speaker: JAROL
text: For his siege!

speaker: JULIANA
text: What is your report? Have you done as I commanded?

speaker: JULIANA
text: Have you captured the girl, Teegra, Jarol's daughter?

speaker: JULIANA
text: Where is she?

speaker: JULIANA
text: Bring her forth that I may see her.

speaker: SUBHUMAN
text: Gone.

speaker: JULIANA
text: Gone?

speaker: JULIANA
text: Gone!

speaker: JULIANA
text: Escaped? You filth-spawned scum!

speaker: JULIANA
text: What punishment does failure demand?

speaker: NEKRON
text: Death.

speaker: JULIANA
text: Find the girl. Find her, or his punishment shall be yours.

speaker: LARN
text: Gods of my father.

speaker: LARN
text: What do you want?

speaker: LARN
text: If you want it, take it.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I am not a thief.

speaker: LARN
text: Not so close, you'll burn it.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I've always lived close to a fire.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Sometimes in the night, I'm so afraid.

speaker: LARN
text: It's getting colder.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Cold comes from Nekron.

speaker: LARN
text: I know.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Where are you going?

speaker: LARN
text: I'm going home to my people.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Where is home?

speaker: LARN
text: Far away, to the south.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I'm going south, too.

speaker: LARN
text: Yeah?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: You can come along if you behave yourself.

speaker: LARN
text: If I behave myself?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: No.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Larn.

speaker: LARN
text: You've caught me, but you'll never hand me over to Nekron.

speaker: LARN
text: You'll have to kill me first.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Don't hunt for death, boy.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: It finds us all soon enough.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: The travois was to keep you from killing yourself till you're all healed.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: You need rest and food.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: If you're gonna kill the Ice Lord, boy, you better learn to live with pain.

speaker: LARN
text: Ice Lord? You mean you're fighting Nekron?

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Him and his mother.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: That wolf bitch, Juliana.

speaker: LARN
text: Teegra!

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: They were here.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Nekron's dogs, they got the girl.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: They took her west.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Guard Teegra.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: They camped less than two miles from here.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Come.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: I saw the girl before. She is on the far side of the big tree.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: You go get her out, and I'll distract the others.

speaker: LARN
text: There must be 50 of them.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: That sounds about right.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Where's the girl?

speaker: LARN
text: I couldn't find her.

speaker: LARN
text: No!

speaker: LARN
text: The horses!

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: No, they'd be on our heels before we could reach them.

speaker: LARN
text: But Teegra's still back there.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Then we'll come back for her.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: First, we lead the Nekron's dogs on a wild chase.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Come.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: We'll take our stand up there. Come.

speaker: JAROL
text: Enough!

speaker: JAROL
text: I want you to go to Nekron, to his mother,Juliana.

speaker: JAROL
text: We must negotiate.

speaker: TARO
text: With the enemy?

speaker: JAROL
text: No man is wholly evil.

speaker: JAROL
text: Surely there is some way to appeal to Nekron.

speaker: TARO
text: You expect his mercy?

speaker: TARO
text: Father, do you know what he will do if I enter his land under a flag of truce?

speaker: JAROL
text: We have no choice!

speaker: JAROL
text: We must take that risk.

speaker: JAROL
text: You must take that risk, my son, for the sake of Fire Keep.

speaker: JAROL
text: For the sake of your sister.

speaker: JAROL
text: Go, ride swiftly.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Welcome to my hearth.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: I am Roliel and these woods are my home.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: You've had a trying journey.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Please let me give you some food and drink.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: First, you shall rest. Then we will talk.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Poor, poor darling.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Did Great Otwa frighten you?

speaker: ROLIEL
text: You mustn't be afraid. He's as gentle as a child.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I saw him twist a chain apart with his bare hands.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Yes, he is strong, my sweet.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: But he means well, my darling . He brought you to me, did he not?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I'm so tired.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Yes, my poor, poor darling.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Yes, you're so tired...

speaker: ROLIEL
text: and so beautiful.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: You must...

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Tell me your secrets.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Nekron?

speaker: ROLIEL
text: The girl is wanted by Nekron? The bitch!

speaker: ROLIEL
text: She brings danger into my house!

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Perhaps I can turn this to my advantage.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Otwa, my son.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Go and bring the subhumans, Nekron's dogs.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Tell them we have the girl that he wants.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Tell them he can have her, for a price.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Kill.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Get out of here.

speaker: LARN
text: No.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: The hell you won't.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Go find the girl.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: Enter, my son. It is not barred.

speaker: ROLIEL
text: What's wrong with you? Where are the dogs?

speaker: ROLIEL
text: You would do this-

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Why do the living...

speaker: SPIRIT
text: disturb the sleep of the dead?

speaker: LARN
text: I followed a trail. I seek a girl, Teegra.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: A girl?

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Yes. She did this to me.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: She and Nekron.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Cursed Nekron.

speaker: LARN
text: Where can I find her?

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Why should I answer?

speaker: LARN
text: For revenge against Nekron.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Nekron?

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Akatar. They take her to Akatar.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: And from there to the Icy King's realm.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Avenge me.

speaker: SPIRIT
text: Avenge me!

speaker: LARN
text: Akatar.

speaker: LARN
text: Teegra!

speaker: SUBHUMAN CAPTAIN
text: My Prince, all is arranged.

speaker: SUBHUMAN CAPTAIN
text: I've hired a ship. It waits for us at the dock.

speaker: SUBHUMAN CAPTAIN
text: Nekron waits at Ice Peak.

speaker: SUBHUMAN CAPTAIN
text: Get the gangplanks aboard. Move, you scum!

speaker: SUBHUMAN CAPTAIN
text: We must be well on our way before sunrise.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Why have you brought me this?

speaker: JULIANA
text: This is your bride, my son.

speaker: JULIANA
text: She will be mother to your sons.

speaker: NEKRON
text: How thoughtful, Mother.

speaker: NEKRON
text: I need no bride, and no sons.

speaker: JULIANA
text: But you need heirs.

speaker: NEKRON
text: I need nothing !

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Nekron?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Nekron, you're a great power in the world.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: You have all that any man ever wants or needed.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: And yet you despair.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: For there is one thing you lack.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: One gift that only you can bestow between our people.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Peace.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: This is the gift that heals the heart of the giver.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Nekron, I extend my hand in friendship.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I offer peace between our people.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Will you not take my hand?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Will you not call me friend?

speaker: NEKRON
text: Woman...

speaker: NEKRON
text: I spit on peace.

speaker: NEKRON
text: I spit on you.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Next time you present me with one of your little sluts, Mother dear...

speaker: NEKRON
text: I'll squash you like a bug.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Get that garbage out of here.

speaker: TARO
text: Don't look up.

speaker: TARO
text: We are riders of Fire Keep. We pay no heed to such trash.

speaker: TARO
text: We have come, Lord Nekron, to negotiate between our two peoples.

speaker: TARO
text: And the return to Fire Keep of my sister, Teegra...

speaker: TARO
text: whom your warriors basely kidnapped.

speaker: TARO
text: My father, King Jarol, has empowered me...

speaker: TARO
text: to offer a peace between our kingdoms...

speaker: TARO
text: in exchange for his continued sovereignty...

speaker: TARO
text: and my sister's freedom.

speaker: NEKRON
text: It seems to me that my envoys made a similar offer not long since...

speaker: NEKRON
text: and that it was spurned by your illustrious sire.

speaker: TARO
text: You know full well, Nekron, that offer was made...

speaker: TARO
text: before your minions kidnapped my sister.

speaker: NEKRON
text: I fear, Good Prince, I cannot offer peace to a people...

speaker: NEKRON
text: who have refused to proclaim me their rightful overlord.

speaker: NEKRON
text: As to your sister...

speaker: NEKRON
text: I must admit that until this moment...

speaker: NEKRON
text: the idea of mating with her filled me with loathing.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Perhaps I should reconsider.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Your sister, after all, is not wholly unattractive.

speaker: NEKRON
text: As lesser beasts go.

speaker: TARO
text: Pig you are.

speaker: TARO
text: And like a pig shall you die.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: No!

speaker: NEKRON
text: No, I don't think so.

speaker: NEKRON
text: You interest me.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Guards!

speaker: NEKRON
text: Bring him to me.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Release him.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Why have you come seeking me?

speaker: LARN
text: You killed my people.

speaker: NEKRON
text: We've had to dispose of so many undesirables of late.

speaker: NEKRON
text: Let him rest. There is still fight in him.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Larn.

speaker: LARN
text: Teegra, is that you?

speaker: LARN
text: Teegra, are you all right?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Yes. I'm trying to unlock the door.

speaker: LARN
text: Never mind the door, you've to get out of here.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: I'm not leaving without you. Maybe I can get a key somehow.

speaker: LARN
text: No, Teegra, don't.

speaker: JAROL
text: Is he certain?

speaker: JAROL
text: It was my son you saw?

speaker: LARN
text: They called him Prince Taro.

speaker: JAROL
text: He died.

speaker: JAROL
text: What about Teegra?

speaker: LARN
text: He's got her, too.

speaker: LARN
text: Maybe she's still alive.

speaker: LARN
text: It's a chance.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Believe what you want, but that glacier is a fact.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: For three days and nights it's been pushing south.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: A thousand souls lost because of Nekron's rage.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Fire Keep is next. We must attack.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: I need the Dragonhawks.

speaker: JAROL
text: The Dragonhawks are too few.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Enough to get in with.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: One us might get through and destroy him.

speaker: JAROL
text: But if that glacier passes beyond the river, I will have no choice.

speaker: JAROL
text: I will have to release the lava.

speaker: LARN
text: Teegra.

speaker: TEEGRA
text: Larn.

speaker: DARKWOLF
text: Nekron!

speaker: LARN
text: Die! Die! Why don't you die?

speaker: TEEGRA
text: No, Larn! No, it's over, don't you see? We have to start over.
